headline: Sensex Rallies 564 Points as Nifty Crosses 23,400 Led by Easing Oil Prices and Sectoral Gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Easing global crude oil prices provided a significant boost to market sentiment
Strong buying interest in Pharma, FMCG, and Realty sectors
Positive global cues and falling Euro area bond yields
Robust demand for the NSE IPO indicating strong investor confidence
whatHappening: The Sensex closed 564 points higher, while the Nifty 50 settled above the 23,400 mark
The NSE IPO was booked over 4 times on its third day, driven by a rush from Institutional Investors
India overtook Hong Kong to become the 4th-largest REIT market in Asia
Petrol pump dealers in Mumbai and Thane raised concerns with the RBI over new UPI MDR charges
summary: Indian markets ended sharply higher on Monday, with the Sensex gaining 564 points and Nifty closing above 23,400. The rally was supported by cooling crude oil prices and strong performance in the pharma and realty sectors. Meanwhile, the NSE IPO saw robust demand, and India emerged as a top REIT market in Asia.
